# Stderr sink parameters

This reference describes the `stderr` sink. The `stderr` sink writes Boundary events to standard error. For configuration instructions, refer to [Configure event sinks](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/configure-sinks#configure-a-stderr-sink).

```hcl
sink "stderr" {
  name        = "all-events"
  description = "All events sent to stderr"
  event_types = ["*"]
  format      = "hclog-text"
}
```

## Parameters

The `stderr` sink has no parameters beyond the [common sink parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/common) that all sink types share.
